label: I-063-prewarm-v12
notes: ATTENDED RUN. THE USER MUST BE AT THE KEYBOARD FOR ALL FOUR CAPTURES. Arms differ by exactly two added files: the variant overlay is agent-I057-b plus gamedata/scripts/zzz_alao_prewarm.script and gamedata/scripts/modxml_zzz_alao_prewarm_tutorial.script (lab/mods/alao-prewarm v1.2). Nothing is replaced and no function is patched. The profiler overlay is gen6-I062's rebuilt walkout build - use the path as given, do NOT rebuild it. WHAT v1.2 ADDS over v1.1, both at actor_on_first_update behind the loading screen: (1) it grows ui_inventory.GUI.CC['actor_bag']'s cell pool and grid to cover the current ruck, plus 12 spare cells, then Reset()s the container so nothing is left indexed - the walk-out trace 20260920-185607-I-062-a1c78b showed every expensive open is a pool-growth open (cells 0->19, grid 0->7, 17.4/9.2/7.9/12.0 ms) and every cheap one is not (cells 19->19, 3.5-4.9 ms); (2) it starts and immediately stops a no-op tutorial to warm the engine tutorial sequencer, which costs exactly one 705/716 ms call per session in bind_campfire.script:176 when the player first walks near a campfire. The no-op tutorial node is injected into ui/game_tutorials.xml by the DXML module; whether that node parses at all is UNVERIFIED OFFLINE and the engine log settles it. This is a HITCH comparison, not an fps or ms/frame one: the player drives the workload by hand, so the mean script ms/frame and the fps delta between the arms mean nothing and must not be quoted. SCRIPTED ROUTINE, identical in every capture: do NOTHING until the 30 s warm-up is over and open NOTHING before the capture starts (the first inventory open of the session must land inside the capture); then at about 0:45 open the inventory (I), wait ~2 s, close it, and after ~10 s open it once more; then walk to the nearest campfire and stand near it until the use prompt appears; then walk away far enough for the prompt to clear and walk back so it triggers a second time; then stop, finishing ~30 s before the end. Read it back with: py -3.12 lab/tools/profile_report.py --queue <id> --listeners --hitch --top 400

pass_conditions.baseline: first open of the session 17.4 / 9.2 / 7.9 / 12.0 ms, with the trace showing cells 0 -> 19 and grid 0 -> 7; every later open 3.5-4.9 ms with cells 19 -> 19
pass_conditions.variant_expected: the first open is an ordinary open: no pool growth, so the same 3.5-4.9 ms band as every later one
pass_conditions.passes_if: variant max_ms <= 6 ms in BOTH variant captures. If the trace overlay is used as well, every trace line must show pre cells == post cells (no growth on any open).
pass_conditions.fails_if: the first open is still >= 7 ms - then either the prewarm did not run (check the [alao_prewarm] lines in xray.log for 'inv pool: N cells + N headroom') or the pool is not what costs and the next suspect is the icon texture bind in UICellItem:Set.

pass_conditions.baseline: exactly ONE call of 705 / 716 ms per capture (a 786 ms frame the player felt), every other call <= 0.8 ms
pass_conditions.variant_expected: no call anywhere near that: the sequencer was warmed at frame 7
pass_conditions.passes_if: NO call >= 50 ms in bind_campfire.script:176 in either variant capture, AND the baseline captures still show one ~700 ms call (otherwise the routine did not reach a campfire and the row says nothing)
pass_conditions.fails_if: a ~700 ms call is still there. Then read the engine log: 'tutorial: alao_prewarm_noop started=false' means the injected XML node did not parse (set TUTORIAL_NAME to an existing tutorial and retry), while 'started=true' with the hitch intact means the cold cost is per-tutorial rather than per-sequencer and this target is dead.

pass_conditions.row: where the prewarm cost shows up
pass_conditions.variant_expected: all of it on lst actor_on_first_update#zzz_alao_prewarm.script at frame 7. v1.1 measured 31.7 / 32.4 ms for the sound + encyclopedia bundle; v1.2 adds the cell pool (19 + 12 UICellItems, i.e. ~124 xml:InitStatic) and one start/stop of the tutorial sequencer, so expect it to grow by roughly the 17 ms the first open used to cost plus the ~700 ms sequencer load on a cold capture.
pass_conditions.passes_if: there is NO lst actor_on_update#zzz_alao_prewarm.script row in the hitch table at all, and the first_update row's first_frame is 7. A first_update of one or two seconds is fine - the loading screen is up until frame ~62.
pass_conditions.fails_if: an actor_on_update#zzz_alao_prewarm row exists (SLICE_SOUNDS was left on), or first_frame is not 7.

pass_conditions.variant_expected: one [alao_prewarm 1.2] done block per level load, with lines: 'inventory: GUI already built, nothing to do' (expected on GAMMA), 'inv pool: 19 cells + 12 headroom, 7 grid rows', 'encyclopedia: get_ui() built', 'tutorial: alao_prewarm_noop started=true stopped=true', 'sounds: 160 built, 0 failed, synchronous at first update'. Plus one '[alao_prewarm] injected <alao_prewarm_noop> into ui\game_tutorials.xml' from the DXML module.
pass_conditions.passes_if: the inv pool line reports a non-zero cell count and the tutorial line reports started=true
pass_conditions.fails_if: 'inv pool: no GUI.CC.actor_bag' (the prewarm ran before FDDA/SortingPlus - listener order changed), 'inv pool: FAILED' (ParseInventory or Reinit is not callable that early), or 'could NOT inject' from the DXML module.

pass_conditions.row: regression check on the rows v1.1 already settled
pass_conditions.baseline: actor_on_footstep max 0.81 with 15 calls over the floor; eft_jump_sounds:71 0.56, :89 0.50; ui_pda_encyclopedia_tab:407 7.39 / 7.08
pass_conditions.variant_expected: unchanged from v1.1: footstep row absent, jump 0.16, land 0.15, encyclopedia ~1.9
pass_conditions.passes_if: no regression on any of these
pass_conditions.fails_if: any of them comes back - then folding the pool and tutorial prewarms into the same first_update disturbed the sound prewarm.

pass_conditions.row: lam2.script:271 - control row, not this mod's
pass_conditions.variant_expected: unchanged; nothing in this mod touches FDDA's action machine
